resources.string: Operates apps for you, by voice

Fingertip reads what is on your screen and taps, types and swipes for you when you ask it to, so you can use any app by voice.

Screen contents stay on your device while Fingertip is carrying out a task you asked for. If Fingertip gets stuck and needs help working out a new task, it sends a description of the current screen for analysis, with passwords, card numbers and one-time codes removed first. It will tell you how many values were hidden.

Fingertip never turns on screen exploration and never takes over your usual screen reader.
